responsibility: Declares the main Rust HIR expression type-checking visitor. TypeCheckExpr exposes the expression-resolution entry point, implements per-expression visit hooks, and declares internal helpers for overloaded-operator lookup, fn-trait call desugaring, root-path and segment resolution, and arithmetic-type validation used while inferring TyTy results for expressions.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TypeCheckExpr visitor interface, its Resolve entry point, and helper methods for operator overloads, fn-trait calls, path resolution, and arithmetic validation. The matching rust-hir-type-check-expr.cc contains the actual expression-type-checking implementations.
